svg.title: harness campaign: a run that continues alone
svg.text: harness campaign: a run that continues alone
Turns follow each other without waiting; Lean's verified frontier is the progress meter, and only the certifier can end a campaign as settled.
(a) TURNS THAT DO NOT WAIT, AND THE FRONTIER THEY ARE JUDGED BY
(c) HOW IT ENDS, AND HOW IT SURVIVES
hint, sign and steer tell the next turn; a question a line would ask
goes into the digest and the work goes on. They change what sessions
are told and the order of work, never a status
A session starts cold, from a dossier
from the original file (empty AUX, the original proof), no notes;
the opening message holds a dossier built by code, at most 750 tokens:
L0 the signed statement and the frontier's top entries
L2 dead ends with counts: failure class, first error, refuted subclaims
L3 unverified lessons, the first to be cut at the bound
its steps follow a geometric schedule; three failures of one class on one
goal end it early; previous_attempt shows the last file on request
ten turns in a row that spent money in a mode and grew nothing:
stopped, reason spiral, "out of reach at this budget"
no mode signs, re-signs or edits it; every goal a mode adds is a
Lean statement or an evidence need, never prose
settled only by the certifier's kernel replay; the frontier is
evidence of progress, never a status
--usd-per-day pauses a day, it does not end the campaign; --until;
lock and heartbeat; harness campaign --watch restarts a dead supervisor;
the next turn starts: nobody is asked
frontier score, from Lean's accepted facts
A plateau changes the mode for a turn, by rule, no model; a mode that
grows the frontier stays, one that adds nothing passes to the next.
stopped, with the frontier and "here is what is established":
